explication: Solr is a multimodal search platform built on Lucene. The documented user workflow is to submit data for indexing and then search it; Solr also supports full-text, vector, and geospatial search. Its API and CLI expose collection and schema management, while SolrCloud coordinates distributed nodes through ZooKeeper. The graph includes these documented capabilities and sampled query, API, clustering, and storage components. Many implementation paths are represented by their enclosing source directories because their individual files were not sampled; uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
